summary_markdown:
The team conducted a database upgrade, which was reported to be successful. Initial concerns about connection warnings (RaftInstance: Election timeout) were noted in the logs but did not prevent data viewing.

Performance testing revealed that complex queries using `select *` are slow and prone to timeouts on large tables (`raw_devices_seen`). It was recommended that users specify only necessary fields instead of selecting all columns, as this is inefficient for column storage databases. The upgrade process itself was deemed a successful 'simple' upgrade.

Discussion also covered general infrastructure topics, including potential GitHub access restrictions and upcoming Ubuntu LTS deadlines.
decisions: The database upgrade was completed successfully.
action_items: Users should avoid using `select *` in queries to improve performance on column storage databases.
